subject: words
title: Sight words 3
about: Twenty-four more high-frequency words, every Dolch second-grade word not already in another level (always, does, those, wash, work) plus five from Fry's second hundred (only, great, mother, world, kind); a few are regular and the rest have a pink part that does not follow his class's code. CKLA Grade 1 does not list these, so treat it as a step-ahead level for spring after Sight words 2; they are the irregularly spelled words NC RF.1.4.g expects him to read at a glance.
tip: Flash each card for two seconds and he should say it straight away; if he gets stuck, point to the pink part and tell him what it says.
